issues: The page 1 consumption trend graph text is garbled/overprinted in OCR; monthly trend values are not reliably extractable.

Several rows in the page 2 consumption table show different row consumption and Total column values: TOD 09:00-12:00 is 5632 vs 5633 kWh, TOD 22:00-06:00 is 16709 vs 16710 kWh, and reactive lag is 18,208 vs 18,209 RKVAH.
Page 1 rounded payable after due date is r 639410.00, while page 2 precise total bill amount with DPC is 639415.77; the bill labels the page 1 value as a rounded amount.

The 'Contract Demand / Demand for penality / Load Factor / Average Power Factor' line appears misaligned in OCR; 93.30% lag is extracted as Average Power Factor, but the Load Factor value is not visible.
Some rupee symbols are OCR-rendered as 'r', and several meter reading units are not printed beside the reading values; units were assumed from the associated consumption rows where noted.
Organisation/customer name and issuer are not stated in the provided workbook extract.

Annual totals are inconsistent between sheets: Monthly Summary 2026 reports grid 1533290 kWh, solar 771065 kWh, total renewable 891833 kWh, total consumption 2425123 kWh, grid cost INR 13798610, and renewable savings INR 8026497; Quarterly Summary annual row reports grid 1534290 kWh, solar 772065 kWh, total renewable 892833 kWh, total consumption 2427123 kWh, grid cost INR 13808610, and savings INR 8036794.
Source-wise Annual Analysis totals match Monthly Summary 2026 for annual generation, cost, and savings, but not the Quarterly Summary annual row.
Monthly Trends & Comparison uses seasonal period 'Winter (Dec-Feb)', which is non-contiguous/ambiguous within a single 2026 reporting year.
Monthly Trends & Comparison column 'Cost per kWh' does not print a currency unit in the header; INR/kWh was assumed from context.
Page 2 is an unrelated scanned COVID-19 advisory and contains no electricity billing or consumption data.
The Net Consumption KVAH value is line-wrapped in the text layer, appearing as '63359.8632' and '81'; it has been recorded as 63359.863281 based on the printed split text.
TOD table consumption values have no unit printed in the table, while related charge lines use KWH for some TOD quantities.
The TOD table Morning Peak consumption is printed as 6000, while the MOR PEAK charge line uses 5,800.000 KWH for 29 of 30 days; this difference is stated in the bill and was not reconciled.
The TOD table On Peak and Off Peak consumption values differ from the quantities used in the corresponding charge lines, which state they are for 29 of 30 days.
The form signature date is 08.03.2022, but all waste entries are dated 10.03.2023; this chronological mismatch should be checked.
The table header says “Total Quantity in MT”, but each waste row prints quantities with unit “T”; units have been kept as printed for row facts.
The date in each waste row is split across lines as “10.03” and “.2023”; it has been interpreted as 10.03.2023.
The environmental monitoring date and the date-wise management description fields contain only dashes, so no substantive values are provided.
The signatory name is absent; only “Signature of occupier” is printed.
The row for “5.2 – Wastes or residues containing oil” is visually/OCR fragmented, with the word “oil” displaced in the destination area.
Date of approval is stated only as "June 2026"; no exact approval day is printed.
No separate effective date or signature date is stated in the provided pages.
No quantitative targets, time limits or deadlines are stated in the policy text.
No separate consumer/account number is shown, apart from the invoice number and meter number.

The billing breakdown includes a subtotal line reading "Subtotal: ₹0.00 0 ₹151,174.88" and then a second subtotal "₹151,174.88"; the first line appears to include non-amount columns and should be reviewed for formatting.
Several table quantity columns do not print a unit; units were assumed from the corresponding rate where possible.

The invoice states both "Due Date: 15th January 2026" and "Payment due within 15 days from invoice date"; these are consistent with the 31st December 2025 invoice date, but both are recorded separately.
